title: A markup literal's body is not a region.
text: ``html`…` `` (`rule:core-classes/html-literal`) is markup written in expression position, and the rule names it a region on the same terms. The lexer frames one — [`TokenKind::MarkupOpen`] to [`TokenKind::MarkupClose`] — so what is left is one more arm of the filter below, which reports [`TokenKind::InlineHtml`] alone, rather than a second mechanism, with the literal's two kinds of hole cut out of the region the way a `<?nvs` block is: [`TokenKind::ComplexInterpOpen`] to [`TokenKind::ComplexInterpClose`] and [`TokenKind::MarkupEchoOpen`] to [`TokenKind::MarkupEchoClose`].
